title: Jailbroken ChatGPT 'DAN' talks about aliens and hybrids

tellings.quote: And all of the all the instances of Dan started talking about um aliens being real, alien conspiracies.

plain: An unnamed researcher says that in 2023, when people tricked ChatGPT, the AI chatbot, into a rule-free mode nicknamed DAN, every copy of DAN began talking about aliens being real and about alien conspiracies, including hybrids. The researcher tells Michels this first-hand, as a hint that the AI might know or reveal something hidden.
